exhibit-caption.purpose: Run-in wine italic label and regular Caslon title.

lede.purpose: Introductory text, 44ch generally; visual-chapter subheads use 36ch. The compact landing hero uses 1.0625rem/1.5 at 72ch.

label.purpose: Primary, secondary and inverse button labels.

caption.purpose: Metadata, thumbnail labels, visual tags and status labels, captions and legal detail.

headline-visual.purpose: Repeated compact Caslon headings for graphic and photographic chapters, held to 15ch.

stage-role.purpose: Single Wine italic role beneath the uncropped concept image; the fictional-concept note remains local metadata.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Button arrow nudges and finite explanatory figure sequences.

motion.name: stage-settle
motion.value: 420ms opacity 0.45 to 1 and clip-path inset(0 3% 0 0) to inset(0); cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
motion.purpose: Feedback after a selected concept image loads; omitted for reduced motion.

motion.name: preview-rail-selection
motion.value: Native horizontal scrollTo, behavior instant; no scroll snap
motion.purpose: Centre the initial or deliberately selected thumbnail within the contact sheet without moving the page vertically. Modified thumbnail clicks retain the native full-image destination.

motion.name: preview-playback
motion.value: 24px/second native scrollLeft, reverse at boundaries; 6500ms main-image selection interval
motion.purpose: Continuous contact-sheet motion and automatic preview selection run only onscreen in a visible document, outside rail hover and studio focus. Explicit pause, manual selection and touch persistently pause. One authored SVG playback icon has a localized accessible label/title and synchronized pressed state. Automatic changes turn live caption announcements off; deliberate selections announce politely. Image failure shows a localized status and clears on another selection. Explicit Play clears temporary hover/focus suspension and resumes immediately while its button retains focus; a subsequent hover or focus entry suspends again.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: Transitions and animations disabled; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Preview playback starts paused; readers may explicitly request play. Concept selection and horizontal navigation have no animated transition.

motion.name: visual-demonstrations
motion.value: Six replayable figures: connections, accounts, context, agents, sandbox and operations; sandbox completes within 4400ms.
motion.purpose: Each of the six replayable figures starts on first entry, rests in a complete state and has a localized replay control hidden without scripts and under reduced motion. Sequences pause offscreen and in a hidden document. Agent bars fill in parallel before merged-output emphasis. Sandbox orders browser, code, retained files, reviewable output and pause/retain/resume emphasis. Complete static states remain without scripts and under reduced motion; no decorative repeating graph motion or generic section reveals.

landingStory.scope: Us and Me landing pages, English and Azerbaijani; inner-page rules remain unchanged.
landingStory.contextualActions: Four existing enquiry links follow adaptation, accounts, sandbox and examples; the real localized form has the correct offering preselected. Sandbox uses the shared inverse button on Wine; the others use the existing primary button. Me registers interest while in development.
landingStory.sandbox: Full Wine field with Light Paper headings, copy and controls; large browser/code/files icons and connecting paths without console or pane borders. Stacked below 720px and three equal columns above, followed by pause/retain/resume. A Light Paper result with Wine text is illustrative and reviewable; scoped access and retained files are not universal capability guarantees.
landingStory.examples: Six illustrative scenarios per offering, with uncropped concepts, request, inline wrapping work steps and result. Underlined text tabs have 44px minimum height, 24px horizontal gaps and Wine selected text/underline. Script enhancement provides selected-panel semantics, roving focus and Left/Right/Home/End keys. Without scripts the first complete scenario remains visible and the tablist stays hidden. Image/narrative split is 7:3 from 720px. Three editorial Us links lead to existing delivered-work case studies, separately from fictional results.
landingStory.composition: A stable authored HTML workspace shell with a rebuilding centre introduces outcomes before supporting capabilities. Other capability explanations retain curved connection paths and unframed tool groups, Anthropic-at-limit to OpenAI fallback routing plus two other accounts, a source-linked context document without admin sidebar, unboxed parallel agents and continuous open operations flow. Square product images and actual buttons remain; frames do not scaffold the open diagrams.

offeringProgression.commercialClarity: Us explicitly offers scoped custom implementation and support, with a short open Scope/Build/Support section before enquiry. Me is personal software in development; interest does not create an account.

workspaceDemo.structure: Stable white product shell with DM Sans UI headings/content, a Caslon wordmark and working Workspace/Files/Agents navigation. Six separately composed HTML work surfaces change topology for the job rather than rename shared rows. Navigation becomes a compact row below 600px. Files/Agents reset inherited minimum heights at 899px and below for content-proportional panes.
workspaceDemo.timing: Request types over 2000–2800ms; centre resets at 25%; primary/context/result root pieces append at 35%/70%/100%. Each root contains task-specific structure. Spatial widget transitions last 650ms using bounded offsets from previous layout positions. Read for 2600ms, then advance; one finite three-scene run.
workspaceDemo.controls: Localized pause/resume freezes typing and widget animations and shows the paused state. Replay starts from the first scene. Native underlined choice buttons animate only the selected scene and synchronize pressed state. Offscreen and hidden-document states halt typing and widget motion. Item, file, pane, task-move, flashcard, grocery, task-review and routine interactions stop automatic scene playback, complete the current scene if necessary and finish pending widget animations. Item selection updates detail; task checkboxes update actual checked/total ratio; routine controls and written state synchronize across Workspace/Agents. Kanban controls move tasks into review and mark them reviewed; flashcard controls reveal/hide the selected explanation; grocery checkboxes update local completion styling.
workspaceDemo.fallbacks: Reduced motion reveals a complete selected scene immediately and hides playback. Without scripts, the first complete result is visible, playback/scene selectors are hidden and visible portal controls disabled. Full request text is available without character-by-character announcements.
workspaceDemo.truthfulness: Authored illustrative scenes with fictional notes; local choices only, no free-form model request, model call or account connection. Us illustrates reporting/follow-up/delivery; Me illustrates day planning/study/meals.

us.reports: Document shelf plus broad paper reading surface.
us.kanban: Three task lanes with working move-to-review controls.
us.roadmap: Milestone rail on Wine; vertical on phones.

me.planner: Weekday strip, time axis and calendar blocks.
me.study: Topic checklist beside a revealable flashcard.
me.meals: Recipe week with working grocery checklist.

modes.responsive: Report shelves, kanban lanes and recipes stack on phones. Outer navigation and product theme remain familiar.

workspaceDemo.stageGeometry: Measure all three complete authored templates at the current width and reserve the maximum workspace height during rebuilding. Files and Agents remain content-proportional.

assetAndCopyBounds.scope: Landing bundles include authored demo, portal polish and setup CSS/JS; omitted from inner pages; global assets unchanged. Visible main includes product UI and setup.

productSurface.typography: DM Sans UI headings and content, semibold 600 titles/labels, regular descriptions; Caslon product wordmark and marketing headings retained. No global font migration.
productSurface.corners: 20px outer, 16px below 600px; 9px navigation/setup actions, 10px shared item/file rows, 12px shared agent/option panels. Task-specific work surfaces vary internal shape within the local product treatment. Global square token remains unchanged.
productSurface.boundary: Wine/Ink accents and existing fonts; local softer product treatment only. Editorial marketing and inner pages retain square, flat treatment; no gradients or blur.

landingStory.sourceIdentity: File previews use independent named source metadata and distinct source excerpts, never task-result descriptions. Source-kind filtering retains each resource name.

steps: Example Calendar/Files sources; at least one required
Review controls and optional pause of automatic preparation
setup.controls: Native Continue/Back/Apply/Start again; current-step semantics and legend focus. Apply changes only local scene, named sources and routine state and focuses the workspace. Editing applied settings clears stale success until reapplied.
setup.fallback: Without scripts, first step with disabled choices and hidden navigation actions.
setup.boundary: No account connection, submission, external action, browser storage or persistence. Us previews joint implementation; Me previews personal setup in development.

narrative.overview:
The original consultancy identity remains the visual authority: warm parchment, dark ink, oxblood wine, Caslon headings and quiet sans-serif reading text. The adaptive AI workspace is presented through original concepts and concise visual explanations. Us and Me inhabit this same world; audience and product content change without introducing a separate consumer identity. The interactive workspace and guided setup have an explicitly scoped, softer product treatment inside the editorial page.

Generous space and hairlines organise the page. Serif display type carries a short proposition; wine italic gives a phrase emphasis; original workspace concepts explain the product at a readable scale. Warm architectural photographs place London and Baku beneath the product on the landing pages and support the practice's context on inner pages. Original concepts, authored HTML demonstrations and open diagrams carry the landing story; longer reading belongs to the site's established article and service surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment surfaces, ink text and oxblood emphasis.
Libre Caslon Display headings, Libre Caslon Text italic and DM Sans reading text.
Square marketing edges, fine rules, tonal bands and generous section rhythm, with softer interactive product surfaces.
Shared components and responsive structure for Us and Me, in English and Azerbaijani.
Large, uncropped workspace concepts, brief illustrative notes and a native thumbnail contact sheet.
Continuous horizontal preview motion with one playback control, initially paused for reduced motion, and a complete static reading surface.

rules.name: The Wine Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Wine carries emphasis, actions and control states across both offerings. Keep secondary copy in Soft Ink or Muted Warm Grey on paper; use Wine Mist for closing-band support and Light Paper for sandbox headings, copy and controls.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, actions and labels use sentence case. Do not introduce decorative preheaders, kickers, uppercase transforms or small-caps label systems.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Use tabular lining figures where the source compares or sequences numbers: ledger cells, stage numbers and durations. Small stage counters are wine.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate and organise the editorial marketing surfaces with fine rules and tonal surfaces. Do not replace this quiet structure with floating panels or shadow elevation; the interactive workspace and guided setup use only their documented local soft elevation.

dos: Do retain the original parchment, oxblood and Caslon identity across Us and Me.
Do use wine italic for meaningful phrase emphasis and fine rules for structure.
Do keep headings and actions in sentence case, with card metadata below the title.
Do label illustrative product concepts and examples honestly; show only verified proof as results.
Do keep small process counters in Wine and reserve Bronze for quiet detail.
Do preserve keyboard focus, native offering links, locale continuity and reduced-motion states.
Do give automatic previews a visible playback control, pause on interaction and start paused for reduced motion.
Do keep styling in the stylesheet under the site's existing no-inline-style policy.
donts: Don't introduce a separate visual identity for Me or reinstate the superseded navy-and-blue Board Pack palette.
Don't add shadows or rounded panels to editorial marketing surfaces; use only the documented local treatment inside the interactive workspace and guided setup. Keep gradients and blur out of both.
Don't put decorative preheaders, kickers or eyebrows above headings, or introduce uppercase label styling.
Don't use coloured side-stripe callouts in place of the established ruled structure.
Don't turn illustrative concepts into release claims or invent metrics, testimonials or client proof.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph icon sets; use the evidenced local SVG icons, inline SVG arrows and CSS affordances, retaining visible labels and asset licenses.
Don't use em dashes in visitor copy or write inline style attributes and style blocks.
